Your Lead Desk in four steps

Whenever you search, the system finds companies that could buy your products, checks them, names the right person and writes the first email. You only check and send.

  1. 1
    Open “Dashboard”

    Your list of buyers to contact, best first, each with the person and a ready email. Start with number 1.

  2. 2
    Click a buyer

    You see who to contact and the ready email. Change anything you like. Press Open in mail app to send it from your own mailbox.

  3. 3
    Press “Mark as sent”

    When they reply, move them along: Replied, Meeting, Sample sent, Customer. The bar at the top counts them.

  4. 4
    Tell the system if it was right

    On each buyer, press Good fit or Wrong fit. The next search learns from your answers.

Want new buyers? Click Find buyers on the left, pick or add a product, choose the countries and press Find buyers.
